description: The latest complete bucket for one linear futures contract at the key plan's interval (1m on Ultra and PAYG, 5m on Max, 1h on Pro, 1d on Free). `values` maps each futures column key to its value: a number, a string for the text columns (`baseAsset`, `quoteAsset`, `contractType`), or null where the venue did not publish it. `ts` (epoch milliseconds, with `tsIso`) and `interval` identify the bucket; `ts` is 0 with empty `values` when the contract has no row. The columns are defined under `futures.metrics` in blackforge_catalog: mark, index, last, best bid and best ask prices; `fundingRate` (per funding interval, a fraction: 0.0001 = 0.01%; venues settle at different intervals) and `nextFundingTime`; `openInterest` (base units) and `openInterestValue` (quote currency) with `openInterestAt`; volume, taker buy volume and trade count; and long and short liquidation counts and notionals (Max and up). `columns` narrows the payload; columns above the plan are dropped and listed in `columnsOmitted`. When present, `quality` holds the row's futures quality `flags` and the column families they call into question (`contaminates`), with a plain-English `qualityNote`; the decode table is `futures.qualityBits` in blackforge_catalog. Contracts are spelled the way each venue spells them: binance, bybit and bitget `BTCUSDT`, okx `BTC-USDT-SWAP`, gate and mexc `BTC_USDT`, kucoin `XBTUSDTM`, dated contracts such as `BTCUSDT_261225`.

columns.description: Optional subset of futures column keys. Omitted: every column the plan includes.

symbol.description: Contract from blackforge_futures_symbols, e.g. BTCUSDT or BTC-USDT-SWAP.

name: blackforge_futures_latest
title: BlackForge futures latest bucket
